entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who commands the invasion and preaches compleation.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invading force of compleated machines.

entities.name: Kwende
entities.description: A master of blades descended from a vanished land, who fought Phyrexians.

entities.name: Horobi
entities.description: A kami risen from the ashes of Reito who brought death to Phyrexians and Kamigawans alike.

entities.name: Reito
entities.description: A place whose ashes gave rise to Horobi.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who retreated to the Furnace Layer, defying Elesh Norn, and told the Mirran resistance 'Let them be'.

entities.name: Furnace Layer
entities.description: Layer of New Phyrexia where Urabrask retreated and the furnace dwellers live.

entities.name: Aegar, the Freezing Flame
entities.description: A figure whose heat and cold magic Phyrexian machines could not adapt to at once.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: A warleader who fights on the frontlines, contrasted with Razia.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: An aloof and untouchable angel, contrasted with Aurelia.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: An alchemist whose concoctions corroded metal and fortified organic tissue.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: A performer who protected Ravnica with courage, charisma, and spiked chains.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane Judith protected.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: Heir to Sisay and her ship, the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A legendary ship that Shanna says deserved justice.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Shanna's ancestor.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Orzhov leader whose predictions of Phyrexian movements saved lives.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Guildmaster of the Orzhov.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: A guild whose web of power Teysa waits at the center of.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: A martyr for worshipping her ancestors who became a spirit of sand, sun, and memory that cannot be compleated.

entities.name: Sram, Senior Edificer
entities.description: A Kaladesh edificer concerned about keeping the city's machinery balanced.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Defender of Thraben who marshaled cathars, townspeople, and ghoulcallers against the horde.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: Thalia's home, threatened by the Phyrexian horde.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: Zealous defender of Kaladesh whom the Consulate was willing to forgive.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: A plane Baral defended.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Kaladesh authority willing to overlook Baral's transgressions.

entities.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
entities.description: An Omenseeker whose fleet carried survivors to safety.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who seeks the perfect Phyrexia and whose knowledge let New Phyrexia strike each plane precisely.

entities.name: Tetsuko Umezawa
entities.description: A fugitive whose talent for slipping behind enemy lines gave Dominaria crucial information.

entities.name: Toshiro
entities.description: Tetsuko's ancestor.

entities.name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
entities.description: A Locthwain ruler who mourns and celebrates as she chooses her next suitor.

entities.name: Seizan, Perverter of Truth
entities.description: An oni who fought on the invaders' side out of hatred for the mortal realms.

entities.name: Kiku, Night's Flower
entities.description: Speaker of a quoted line about the wisdom of the oni.

entities.name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
entities.description: A spirit risen from a frog that ate the maggot Yar-Kul, who ate enough oil to clean up most of Urborg.

entities.name: Yar-Kul
entities.description: Belzenlok's lieutenant, transformed into a maggot by the Demonlord.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A Demonlord who transformed Yar-Kul into a maggot.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A land Yargle helped clean of oil.

entities.name: Squee, the Immortal
entities.description: An immortal goblin who became a king and symbol of defiance against Phyrexians.

entities.name: Valduk, Keeper of the Flame
entities.description: A keeper of the Flame.

entities.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
entities.description: A hedron-user who realized their explosive magical potential.

entities.name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
entities.description: A fighter with a score to settle with Koma.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: A great serpent challenged by Fynn.

entities.name: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
entities.description: A creature with a fearsome name.

entities.name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
entities.description: A gardener who whispered rites over the fallen so machines could not repurpose them.

entities.name: Firesong and Sunspeaker
entities.description: Figures of the Hurloon peaks.

entities.name: Firja, Judge of Valor
entities.description: A judge who answers invaders with 'Unworthy.'

entities.name: Juri, Master of the Revue
entities.description: An artist who intervened in the invasion.

entities.name: Lathiel, the Bounteous Dawn
entities.description: A hunter who cast aside her bow, struck by a majestic creature.

entities.name: Radha, Coalition Warlord
entities.description: A Keldon warlord who wants to fight Sheoldred.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: Warriors Radha speaks for.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor Radha vows to face.

entities.name: Raff, Weatherlight Stalwart
entities.description: Crew member who defends the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Reyav, Master Smith
entities.description: A smith whose energy shield demonstration saved lives.

entities.name: Rona, Sheoldred's Faithful
entities.description: A follower of Sheoldred who wished to strip away her humanity.

entities.name: Yarok, the Desecrated
entities.description: A being said to grieve within the waste of Bala Ged.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A corrupted land.

entities.name: Atraxa, Praetors' Voice
entities.description: A praetor commanded by Elesh Norn.

events.summary: Urabrask retreats to the Furnace Layer, defying Elesh Norn's commands while the other praetors prepare for invasion.
events.quote: While the other praetors eagerly prepared for invasion, Urabrask retreated to the Furnace Layer, defying Elesh Norn's commands.

events.summary: Belzenlok transforms the ambitious Yar-Kul into a maggot; a frog eats it and a spirit bursts forth.
events.quote: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot.

events.summary: When the Mirran resistance arrives, Urabrask decrees 'Let them be.'
events.quote: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance.

events.summary: Thalia marshals cathars, townspeople, and ghoulcallers into a fighting force to defend Thraben.
events.quote: No stranger to monstrous foes, Thalia marshaled surviving cathars, townspeople, and even ghoulcallers into an unbreakable fighting force.

events.summary: Inga's fleet carries survivors to safety through currents Phyrexians cannot track.
events.quote: Her fleet bore countless survivors to safety, slipping swiftly through strange currents no Phyrexian could track.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias's knowledge lets New Phyrexia strike each plane precisely.
events.quote: His knowledge of the Multiverse enabled New Phyrexia to strike each plane with surgical precision.

events.summary: Yargle eats enough Phyrexian oil to clean up most of Urborg.
events.quote: But Yargle was not most living things, and he ate enough to clean up most of Urborg.

events.summary: Squee becomes both a king and a symbol of defiance against Phyrexians.
events.quote: Naturally, he found himself as both.

events.summary: Yedora whispers rites over the fallen, returning their essences to the land before machines can repurpose them.
events.quote: She whispered ancient rites over the fallen, bidding their essences return to the land before they could be repurposed by the machines.

events.summary: Elesh Norn orders Atraxa to teach a people the price of their insolence.
events.quote: Teach these people the price of their insolence.

events.summary: Firja speaks 'Unworthy' to each invader who falls before her.
events.quote: Invader after invader fell before her, and to each she spoke a single word: "Unworthy."

events.summary: Reyav's demonstration of a portable energy shield saves lives.
events.quote: His impromptu demonstration of the portable energy shield attachment both saved lives and increased demand for aether-powered multi-tool gauntlets tenfold.

relations.quote: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot.
While Kaya is guildmaster, Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.

relations.note: Fynn challenges Koma to a rematch
relations.quote: Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?
